**HOME REPORT VALUATION £225,000**

Situated in a fantastic waterfront location in Granton, this well-proportioned two-bedroom, two-bathroom flat offers an appealing blend of practical living space and coastal surroundings.


The property features a spacious sitting room, two bedrooms, an en-suite bathroom, an additional shower room, and a compact, well-arranged kitchen. The generously sized sitting room provides an inviting space for relaxing or entertaining, while the galley style kitchen is thoughtfully arranged to maximise the available space. A particularly useful feature is the study space situated off of the sitting, ideal for home working or as a dedicated space for hobbies. The principal bedroom benefits from its own en-suite facilities, and the secod bedroom provides functionality as a home office, guest room or nursery. An additional shower room serves the rest of the property. The central hallway connects the accommodation and provides access to two useful storage cupboards.

Positioned right by the waterfront, the property is ideally placed for enjoying scenic coastal walks and the open outlooks associated with Edinburgh's shoreline. Further benefits include gas central heating, double glazing, ample storage, and access to a very well-maintained large rear garden.

Lower Granton Road is situated in the popular coastal district of Granton, to the north of Edinburgh city centre. The area is well suited to those who enjoy outdoor pursuits, with the waterfront close by and opportunities for walking, cycling and enjoying the surrounding coastal scenery.

Granton has seen ongoing regeneration, with a growing selection of local amenities and residential developments. Nearby areas, including Trinity, Newhaven and Leith, offer a wider choice of shops, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities. The nearby waterfront and Newhaven Harbour provide attractive destinations for a stroll or a meal out.

Public transport links connect the area with Edinburgh city centre and other parts of the capital, while road links provide access to the wider city and beyond. The location offers an appealing balance of coastal surroundings and urban convenience.

All window furnishings (curtains, curtain poles, blinds etc), floor coverings, light fixtures, and appliances (both integrated and free standing) are included in the sale. No warranties or guarantees will be provided.

A characterful two-bedroom lower maisonette, combining original architectural features, clever bespoke design, contemporary finishes and a private garden to create a unique, stylish and highly practical home.


This 2- bedroom lower maisonette offers a beautifully unique blend of clever design, practical living and original architectural character.

The living room is a real highlight, where exposed original stonework adds texture, warmth and an authentic feel. A wood-burning stove creates a cosy focal point, complemented by built-in shelving for logs, books and decorative pieces. The pale light timber flooring introduces a light, Scandinavian-inspired feel, balancing the natural stone with warmth and simplicity. Long, understated display shelves provide space for artwork and personal touches, while sliding patio doors open directly onto the decking, allowing natural light to flow through and creating a seamless connection between the interior and garden.

The kitchen has been handcrafted by the current owners, making clever use of the available space through bespoke worktops and storage. White tiles with contrasting dark grout, a deep ceramic sink and matt-black tap create a contemporary finish, while the flush electric hob keeps the worktop streamlined, maximising both functionality and visual appeal. A particularly clever feature is the fold-down chopping board, positioned at a comfortable working height and designed to make food preparation easy, with scraps conveniently brushed straight into the sink. Compact yet highly functional, the kitchen demonstrates how thoughtful design and craftsmanship can transform a smaller space into something both practical and visually cohesive.

The property offers two bedrooms, each with the flexibility to suit different lifestyles. The first bedroom provides an opportunity to create a multifunctional space, whether used as a bedroom, a dedicated home office, study or additional sitting room. The second bedroom is generously proportioned, offering ample room for furniture while retaining a comfortable, open feel. Wall-mounted bike hooks introduce a practical, design-conscious storage solution, keeping bicycles neatly organised while making the most of the available floor space.

The bathroom continues the property's distinctive design language, combining crisp white tiling with contrasting black grout and matt-black shower fittings. A rich green ceiling introduces a bold, botanical-inspired accent, bringing depth and colour to the otherwise neutral palette. The natural timber vanity unit, integrated basin and concealed storage soften the contemporary finishes, creating an earthy, spa-like atmosphere. The combination of organic materials, tonal contrast and carefully selected details gives the space a distinctive, cohesive feel.

A further standout feature is the outdoor space, with French patio doors leading onto a decked area surrounded by fenced green lawn. Whether enjoying a morning coffee, entertaining friends or making the most of the opportunity to grow your own vegetables, herbs or flowers, the garden offers a welcome connection to the outdoors and plenty of potential to make it your own.

This property benefits from a layout and design that make excellent use of every space, with original features, handmade finishes and thoughtful storage adding to its individuality. The combination of character, flexible accommodation and private outdoor space makes this an appealing home for those looking for somewhere with personality, practicality and comfort.
